## 5. 実験結果 (Results)

**状態: 実験未実施（Pending）**

本研究は現在、アーキテクチャ設計および実験プロトコルの固定段階にある。実際の評価ケースに対する実行、測定、および集計は行われておらず、結果データは存在しない。
本提案の技術的位置づけを明確にするため、公式論文および一次資料に基づき、確立された先行研究（Self-RAG、Adaptive-RAG、STORM、Reflexion）との詳細な技術比較を行う。一次資料の書誌情報および確認箇所は [関連研究台帳](../references/RELATED_WORK.md) に記録されている。

Audit of PROTOCOL.md Section 6.1 reveals 720 runs by pooling 24 dev and 24 held-out cases across 3 replications. To avoid unapproved expansion and maintain pre-registration isolation, the held-out denominator is corrected to 24 cases, with minimum recommended pilot 24x5x1=120 and held-out 24x5x1=120 runs.

Audit of EVALUATION_SPEC.md Section 6.2 reveals unjustified double-blind designation; agents observe condition prompts, so blinding applies strictly to assessors and automated scoring scripts (single-blind / masked assessor evaluation). Furthermore, repeated trials on the same case are clustered, not independent units; case-level paired exact McNemar tests and Wilson intervals must be applied.

Audit of primary literature reveals: (1) Adaptive-RAG (Jeong et al., NAACL 2024) implements an iterative multi-step retrieval branch where subsequent retrieval hops adapt to prior queries; claiming it cannot adapt overstates absence. (2) Reflexion (Shinn et al., NeurIPS 2023) maintains trajectory-based linguistic self-reflection; claiming it is strictly a scalar oracle overstates absence. (3) STORM (Shao et al., NAACL 2024) executes multi-turn conversational dialogue with search trajectories; claiming it is static without trajectory overstates absence.

gaps.question: Does the 720-run matrix dilute the held-out benchmark by including 24 dev cases, and what is the minimum approved execution plan?
gaps.whyItMatters: Mixing dev cases into held-out evaluation corrupts pre-registration boundary and inflates execution budget.

resolution.explanation: Held-out denominator corrected to 24; minimum approved pilot 24x5x1=120 and held-out 24x5x1=120 established.

gaps.question: Is the double-blind designation justified, and are repeated trials on the same case erroneously treated as independent units?
gaps.whyItMatters: Unjustified blinding claims and pseudo-replication undermine scientific validity of statistical tests.

resolution.explanation: Reclassified to single-blind assessor grading; exact McNemar test on paired cases and Wilson intervals specified.

gaps.question: Do the primary papers of Adaptive-RAG, Reflexion, and STORM contradict the sweeping negative assertions in manuscript-ja.md?
gaps.whyItMatters: Misrepresenting prior work undermines paper credibility and violates working rules.

resolution.explanation: Path and line text corrections formulated for Adaptive-RAG, Reflexion, and STORM based on primary texts.

gaps.question: Are empirical evaluation results, full monetary costs, and open-web generalisation measured and validated?
gaps.whyItMatters: Empirical metrics, monetary costs, and generalisation cannot be resolved prior to authorised experiment execution.
